dict.string: Signal Path reads local schedule density only after you explicitly enable schedule hints. It creates gentle Energy Budget context on this device; event titles, locations, attendees, and notes are not stored or uploaded.

Signal Path reads local schedule density only after you explicitly enable schedule hints. It creates gentle Energy Budget context on this device; event titles, locations, attendees, and notes are not stored or uploaded.
Signal Path reads the sleep, step, and workout data you choose to share, then creates abstract Energy Budget recovery hints on this device. Raw health data is not uploaded.
Signal Path does not add or modify Health data. Health access is read-only and supports optional Energy Budget recovery hints.
Signal Path uses the microphone to turn your voice into editable signal text. Audio is processed only during recognition and is not saved or uploaded.
Signal Path lets you choose a profile photo for your Me page. The photo stays on this device unless you choose to share it elsewhere.
Signal Path uses only on-device speech recognition to turn your voice into editable signal text. If on-device recognition is unavailable, you can still type. Audio is not saved or uploaded.
